scope: All 27 requirement sections, 66 device scenarios, 80 per-device lifecycle scenarios, retained official manual body M0003–0142, package schema/preset/native-presence inventories, source locators and frozen payload integrity. No runtime, extracted execution, implementation or handoff release review.

findings.problem: Both probes start with Note On Latch on and then automate/edit Length. REQ-NATIVE-MIDI-015 and retained manual M0084 state that Latch deactivates Length and Gate. In particular L05 does not supply an executable visible-control edit for its claimed undo probe; L01 does not say whether disabled-control automation is itself the intended subject. The documented disabled state is being ignored by the lifecycle setup.
findings.requested_change: Use a Length-enabled Latch-off setup for active Length automation/undo, or choose an enabled control with the held-note setup. If automation of a disabled Length control is intentionally under investigation, state that as a separate explicit U input-capability probe rather than assuming the edit can occur. Preserve null event oracles.

findings.problem: Pitch Range is set as 12st although the cited M0093–0097 prose does not specify the Range control unit or width/end semantics. The spec/research correctly keep these unknown and source preset values are explicitly not a decoder. These lower-bound cases do not need the extra semitone-unit assertion.
findings.requested_change: Use an accepted positive Range value as shown in the UI, with unit/upper endpoint U, or cite a pinned unit authority. Retain Pitch0 and safely below-Lowest inputs.

findings.problem: The at-most50 random-displacement predicate does not identify its baseline (raw incoming velocity versus unrandomized mapped output), while the draft leaves transfer/processing order unknown. Input100 plus the60..127 output interval makes a raw-input displacement bound vacuous. The interval portion is supported, but this row is not yet a usable numerical modulation comparator.
findings.requested_change: Before fixture conversion, define a supported comparison baseline and isolate all relevant nonrandom controls, or keep the modulation-displacement comparison U while retaining the documented output-interval predicate. Do not infer a transfer equation.
